import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    return (params[0]*np.sqrt(t) + params[1]*np.log(1+params[2]*A)*t
            + params[3]*np.sin(params[4]*np.sqrt(A))*np.sqrt(t)
            + params[5]*A**params[6]*t**params[7]*np.exp(-params[8]*A))
